title: Define source-linked formal-meeting procedural observations
summary: Represent observed and inferred procedural events with exact original-clock evidence, body/agenda context, alternatives and applicability. This contract supports formal-meeting learning while keeping parliamentary concepts out of Matter's core.
out_of_scope: Assigning legal effect to a spoken motion
Verified voice identity from a recognized name
A universal Robert's Rules implementation assumed for every jurisdiction
implementation: Define a strict DIAT experimental event schema over neutral observation/evidence references, including event family, span, source/package IDs, raw cue, alternatives, extractor/model version and uncertainty.
Separate session/body, agenda, floor, motion/amendment, discussion, vote and exception event families; preserve multiple events and quoted/hypothetical speech without automatic occurrence claims.

Accept profile applicability references from the crawler-owned export and preserve absent/unknown procedures; define optional second/threshold fields without filling defaults from generic parliamentary knowledge.
Provide an exporter to Matter's neutral evidence/claim contract with experimental authority and no person-resolution write capability.
Create invented sequences and annotation examples with actual/suspected/missing events and interval overlaps.

acceptance.criterion: Every event retains its source span, extraction version and observed/inferred distinction.
acceptance.verification: Round-trip representative event records and verify linkage to original-clock turns and source hashes.

acceptance.criterion: Quoted or hypothetical motion text and recognition cues do not become votes or verified speakers.
acceptance.verification: Test exact phrase controls in quotation, discussion and actual event contexts; preserve ambiguity when evidence cannot distinguish them.

acceptance.criterion: Unsupported local procedure remains unknown without falling back to a universal rule.
acceptance.verification: Validate a profile with no second requirement and another with missing rules; outputs differ only by supported profile evidence.

acceptance.criterion: The export validates through neutral Matter schemas without a DIAT dependency in the core.
acceptance.verification: Run contract fixtures through the core and the independent DIAT serializer.

tests: Motion uttered without a stated second
Joint body reconvening during one recording
Unintelligible overlapping event with multiple candidates
risks: Procedure vocabulary can be mistaken for a legally complete rule set.
Source text can report prior meetings rather than an event happening now.

reuse.application: Use existing source-span/turn/recording identities and validation.
Treat local parsing conventions as profile evidence and optional event cues.

sources: jevinmatter: formal-meeting/procedural brainstorm, proposed not measured.

User clarification, 2026-10-08, active Matter build: DIAT owns meeting learning; roughly 315 hours/5–10 recurring people is user-reported; crawler owns jurisdiction knowledge; private exported-data experiments only.
Original repository inputs: matterbrainstormspec; matterjevmesh; jevinmatter (brainstorming, not implementation evidence).
